script: I thought eBay was safe—then the postal inspectors exposed my nightmare.. I deleted the post yesterday because I was getting a dozen people trying to monetize it. The first one hit me with a DM saying, "Let me sell your story for a hundred bucks." I laughed and sent them the link to my old post. Then the next guy slid in a comment, "Bro, I can turn this into a podcast, you get paid." I was like, "Dude, that's my life." The audacity, bestie—people thinking my experience was a gold mine for them. I realized the stakes were real: my privacy, my reputation, and the fact that I'd spent months gathering that story. If I let them take it, I'd lose control of my narrative and maybe get sued for copyright. I pulled the thread, posted a quick apology, and said I was going to take down the content. The loop was that I didn't expect this backlash. I was like, "Why are they so eager to profit from my pain?" I felt a chill—my story was turning into a cash cow for strangers. I didn't want that. So I deleted it. That's how it ended—no more monetization, just me keeping my story.
